name: Daveth
source: As a future ruler, Daveth has shown to be even more charismatic and hardworking than his father with his many accomplishments. However, when it comes to the matter of heart, he's much more inept. It isn't his fault to be blamed when the love of his life cared more about duty than their engagement.
